hero.title: Grupo Amigos
hero.subtitle: Mexican authenticity with a sophisticated twist. Haute cuisine, urban art, and a vibrant atmosphere that transform every meal into a unique sensory experience.

sections.title: Resultado
sections.description: For Grupo Amigos, we developed an advertising spot highlighting a unique culinary proposal: on the Plaza Mayor terrace, you can enjoy Italian, Indian, and Mexican cuisine in one place. The video was projected in cinema halls and combined an aesthetic with attractive shots of the dishes, spaces, and diners' experience. The visual strategy reinforced the identity of both restaurants, increasing their visibility and attracting a diverse audience seeking variety without moving from one spot.
